items.title: Vincent Pelote interviewed by Monk Rowe, Orlando, Florida, February 25, 2017
items.q: Even the Creed Taylor stuff that he did later with the “California Dreamin’” and that stuff.

ctx.x: What’s on your desert island playlist?

Ah the old desert island. I should always think about that more, because, and of course it changes all the time I mean. Of course I’d have to have a Wes Montgomery record, and as to what my favorite one is it’s kind of hard to say because I like all of them. Even the Creed Taylor stuff that he did later with the “California Dreamin’” and that stuff. Probably if I had to pick one I’d probably pick “The Incredible Jazz Guitar” Wes Montgomery. That’s what everybody says is probably the best one. I’d have to have…

about 35 minutes long but it’s great. I mean there’s not a track on there where you’re waiting for it to get over to get to the next track. Every track is perfect. I just love that record. So I guess those are enough.
